description:
RAST Blazor yığını: MainWeb, AppDb, Application, migratorlar, ExternalProject (Service, Scheduler).
      AppCore (Rast.Common, Rast.AdminWeb, Rast.WebFormScaffold, …) yalnızca NuGet; WebFormScaffold kaynak proje olarak üretilmez.
      Kurulum: dotnet new install <path-to-nupkg>
      Örnek: dotnet new rast-blazor -n MyPortal --CompanyName Acme --DatabaseName myportal_db
title: RAST — Blazor stack + AppCore NuGet
